title: The Pawn the Knight Left Behind
setup: The Najdorf pawns did their job: ...a6 and ...b5-b4 have just driven White's knight out to a4. Collect what that knight was guarding.
hint: A knight has just left the center for the edge. Ask which white pawn lost its last defender when it went.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight chased to a4 was the only white piece guarding e4. Pushing the queenside pawns at it was about that square.

{{Nxe4}} takes the pawn. White gets some play for it, but the pawn is Black's. Watch the long diagonal: {{Qf3}} hits the knight with the rook on a8 lined up behind it, and {{Bb7}} or {{d5}} shuts that diagonal, while {{Nc5}} would drop the rook.

A wing pawn push is often a question for a piece in the center.
